edgeone.grpc_status_note: Disabled. The global switch was briefly enabled during evaluation, then restored off after checking protocol compatibility. Tencent documents EdgeOne gRPC support only for Simple RPC and server-side streaming; Xray VLESS gRPC Tun uses bidirectional streaming, so compatibility is not established.

verification.bare_xhttp_get_note: Unauthenticated GET without XHTTP transport framing; 404 is inconclusive and is not counted as protocol validation.
verification.phone_client_test_note: Both previously known wireless-debugging endpoints were offline during this check.
verification.note: TLS and the WebSocket upgrade reached the EdgeOne-backed origin. Xray has WS, gRPC, and XHTTP inbounds; Nginx routes /vless-xhttp to xray:10082, and the live phone subscription allocation includes tx-ws, tx-grpc, and tx-xhttp-h2. The authenticated XHTTP path has not been tested from RikoClash. A plain unauthenticated GET returned 404 and is inconclusive. EdgeOne's documented gRPC modes do not include the bidirectional mode used by Xray Tun.
